content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Infrastructure sovereignty is not a workaround; it's a strategic choice made by creators who want full control over their digital commerce stacks. When platforms like Stripe and PayPal restrict access, NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers empower you to own your pipeline, processing transactions on-chain with a 0.5% fee. This infrastructure is not a replacement, but an upgrade, providing a decentralized, reliable, and efficient way to receive digital payments for your ebooks, courses, and other digital products.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To deploy NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers, you'll need a few essential tools: a Cloudflare account, a NOWPayments account, and a basic understanding of Cloudflare Workers and the NOWPayments API. You can also leverage the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), a pre-configured solution that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, ready to process 5 products, with SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested before handoff.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

In this section, we'll walk you through setting up your payment pipeline using NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers. You'll create a new Cloudflare Worker, connect it to your NOWPayments account, and configure the payment webhook to receive on-chain transactions. We'll also cover how to set up automatic file delivery using Cloudflare R2, ensuring seamless delivery of your digital products to customers worldwide.
NOWPayments processes USDT transactions on Tron or Solana with fees under $0.10 per transaction.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

The fee structure of NOWPayments is fundamentally different from conventional platform fees. NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. There is no monthly fee, no setup fee, no payout fee, and no minimum transaction volume requirement. Network fees for the underlying blockchain transaction are paid by the buyer and vary by network — Tron fees are under $0.10, Solana fees are fractions of a cent, Bitcoin fees average $1 to $5 for most transactions. For a $97 product sold through the Sovereign Starter Stack, the total transaction cost is approximately $0.49 to NOWPayments plus network fees typically under $0.10 on Tron. Compare this to Gumroad's 10% fee on the same transaction — $9.70.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital business grows, it's essential to scale your infrastructure to meet increasing demands. In this section, we'll provide you with actionable tips and strategies to optimize your payment pipeline, manage growth, and ensure that your customers continue to receive seamless delivery of their digital products. You'll also learn how to leverage tools like Supabase and Cloudflare Pages to enhance your infrastructure and improve performance.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

Getting paid in crypto is operationally simpler than it appears. You configure your wallet address in NOWPayments once — this takes under 30 minutes. From that point, every sale deposits automatically into your wallet without any action required from you. The transaction hash in your order log is cryptographic proof of every payment. When you want to convert to local currency, you transfer USDT from your wallet to your exchange account and post a P2P sell order. The buyer sends local currency to your bank account or mobile money account and you release the USDT. Most P2P transactions complete in under 30 minutes.
Cloudflare Workers enable you to process payments on-chain with a 0.5% fee.

If you're looking for a more comprehensive solution, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, ready to process 5 products, with SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested before handoff. For more products, visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Configure your payout destination before configuring your store. Your self-custody wallet address goes into NOWPayments as the destination for each coin you accept — this is where funds land when a transaction confirms on-chain. Never use an exchange wallet address as your NOWPayments destination — use a self-custody wallet where you control the private keys. Set up Binance P2P or a local exchange and verify the conversion process for your local currency pair. Deploy your stack and run a mainnet test. After the first real sale confirms, wait for the transaction to fully clear in NOWPayments, then transfer from your self-custody wallet to your exchange for conversion.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I receive USDT payments on Tron or Solana?

To receive USDT payments on Tron or Solana, you'll need to set up a NOWPayments account, create a new Cloudflare Worker, and configure the payment webhook to receive on-chain transactions. You'll also need to configure automatic file delivery using Cloudflare R2 to ensure seamless delivery of your digital products to customers worldwide.
What is the fee structure for NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee for all transactions, with no KYC requirements or buyer account necessary. This fee is significantly lower than traditional payment platforms, making it an attractive option for digital creators looking to process payments on-chain.
Can I use NOWPayments to process payments in multiple cryptocurrencies?
Yes, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron and Solana, making it an ideal solution for digital creators who want to process payments in various cryptocurrencies.
How do I troubleshoot common issues with NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers?

To troubleshoot common issues, ensure that your NOWPayments account is correctly configured, verify that your Cloudflare Worker is properly set up, and check the NOWPayments API documentation for troubleshooting guides. You can also reach out to the NOWPayments support team for assistance.
Can I use NOWPayments to process payments for digital products on platforms other than Shopify?

Yes, NOWPayments can be integrated with various platforms, including Shopify, WooCommerce, and BigCommerce, making it a versatile solution for digital creators who want to process payments across different platforms.
